capabilities: Highlight fluff words and phrases while editing
Enable or disable four built-in rulesets
Add custom words, phrases, and exceptions
Choose how matches are displayed (dim, strikethrough, underline, none)
Apply custom formatting via a fluff class in user stylesheets
extras: The README states all processing happens locally and no text is sent to a remote server.
motivation: The author states that great writing is clear and concise and built the plugin to help with editing.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in tool to flag unnecessary or cluttered wording while editing prose.
summary: Writing checker that highlights weak qualifiers, cliches, redundancies, and wordy phrases in notes.
